High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is first application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "B.N.S.S."), for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.65/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station -Bagh, District - Dhar (M.P.) for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366(A), 376(3), 376(2)(N), 344, 323, 506 and 109 of the IPC and Sections 3/4 and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.

After arguing for sometime, learned counsel for the applicant seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the bail application with liberty to renew the prayer after examination of the prosecutrix and her parents before the trial court.
The other side has no objection.
With the aforesaid liberty, M.Cr.C. is dismissed as withdrawn, accordingly.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE Shruti NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31948 2 MCRC-45034-2024 Dilip vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16316682/
